sources.title: GitHub - OpenBuddy/OpenChoice
sources.snippet: Turn context into a clear choice. Model: OpenBuddy/OpenChoice-4B-v1 · Project OpenChoice-4B-v1 is a system-1 choice model for decisions expressed in natural language. Supply a state, a question, and 2–16 candidates. Get a selected candidate ID and a probability distribution in one forward pass.
